description: Rothco's Trailblazer Laptop Bag is a perfect blend of durability and style, designed for the modern adventurer. Constructed from heavyweight washed canvas, this laptop bag is built to withstand the rigors of daily use while providing a vintage aesthetic. Leather accents add a touch of sophistication, making it suitable for both casual and professional settings. The padded interior features a stretch strap that securely holds your laptop or other electronic devices, ensuring they remain safe during transport. The front flap, equipped with 4 large brass grommets, adds a rugged touch while keeping the crossbody bag securely closed. Underneath the flap, you'll find 2 additional front pockets, perfect for organizing smaller items like chargers, notebooks, or your phone. A side pocket with a canvas brown leather flap and brass snap provides extra storage, making this bag as functional as it is stylish. The leather-topped carry handle and adjustable padded shoulder strap offer comfort and versatility, whether you're heading to work or exploring new trails. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
